package main import ( "context" "fmt" ) type Name string func (n Name) String() string { return string(n) } // Page's Show takes a ctx in both overloads, neither fitting better. type Page struct{ N Name } func (p Page) Show(ctx context.Context, v fmt.Stringer) string { return v.String() } func (p Page) Show(ctx context.Context, v any) string { return "any" }

{Show(N)}
